overview: Detailed refinements to Enki Phase 1 from chat discussions, building on master blueprint. Focuses on waterproofing PM workflows for small subcontractors, with patterns: upload/parse/AI-assist/generate/review/one-click. Preserves all granularity, including user inputs, proposal variants, contract examples, and decisions.

sections.name: Real-World PM Process Mapping to Phase 1A Subphases
details: 1a-i: Scope Review/Comparison/Red-Lining: Piece together scope from subcontract + proposal (e.g., Hillmont screenshot's vague 'Retaining walls' at $10,050 vs. Greenway-Gartens' detailed $3,300 slab edges per detail 2/A07.20) + emails. AI flags mismatches, value deltas (e.g., contract $812K vs. proposal total), and waterproofing risks (e.g., no substrate spec for concrete pours).

1a-ii: Exhibit Generation with Triggers: Dynamic clauses based on parsed scope (e.g., if 'membrane' detected, add 'GC confirms 4-week lead time; hold harmless for delays'). Boilerplate for exclusions (e.g., de-watering from proposals). Editable UI preview.
1a-iii: Negotiate/Revise/Sign: One-click email drafts with red-lines/exhibits; re-upload revised contract for AI diffs (e.g., 'GC accepted VOC clause'). Stub e-sign.

sections.name: Proposal Parsing and Trust-Tiered Variants
details: 8 templates—detailed 'by location' (qtys/U/M per building, e.g., Greenway Bldg A $111,900 with $3,300 for 1,650 SQ FT bituminous dampproofing on slab edges per detail 2/A07.20, $2,460 for 421 SQ FT sheet waterproofing on elevator walls, $1,330 for 222 SQ FT traffic coatings, $6,730 for 1,922 SQ FT air barriers, $98,080 for 20,865 FT joint sealants including vinyl windows).
Aggregated 'by division' (CSI totals like $70,870 sheet waterproofing without qtys).

Minimal/low-trust (descs/prices only, e.g., Hillmont $812,030 total with $10,050 for bituminous dampproofing retaining walls, $172,710 for self-adhering sheet waterproofing, $21,950 for traffic coatings, $129,930 for fluid-applied membrane air barriers, $477,390 for joint sealants).
Hybrids (location without qtys, e.g., Greenway low-trust variant with Bldg A $3,300 dampproofing).

Enki Adaptation: Upload high-trust internal version for analysis (even if low-trust sent to GC); normalize to JSON (e.g., {csi: '07 92 00', items: [{desc: 'Vinyl Windows', qty: null in low-trust}]}). Infer risks from sparsity (e.g., 'Vague qtys: Amp lead time clauses'). Waterproofing focus: Triggers for substrates, VOC/jurisdiction, staging.

sections.name: Contract Parsing and Segmentation
details: Locked Source of Truth: Executed contract parsed/segmented in 1A; no re-uploads in later phases.
Hybrid Grok Models: Grok 4 for breakdown (e.g., extract essentials/risks from West End's TOC/exhibits), grok-4-1-fast-reasoning for refinements (e.g., generate exhibits from parsed JSON).
Sectional Splitting: Simple page extraction to PDFs (e.g., 'schedule.pdf' from West End page 156 Gantt); store in Supabase. Defer deep parse to phases (e.g., 1F for dependencies).
Prompt Organization: Centralized shared modules (e.g., insuranceModule) + phase-specific files (e.g., 1a-prompts.ts composing scope/comparison).

Manual Specs Upload in 1A: Optional for CSI resolution/merging (e.g., upload 03 30 00 Cast-in-Place Concrete; ref in exhibits: 'Substrate must meet 03 30 00 per manual Section 3.3 [quote: Concrete shall be cured 28 days min, flat to 1/4 inch in 10 feet]').

sections.name: Schedule Handling
details: Original as Baseline: 1A maps embedded schedule (e.g., West End Gantt tasks like 'Foundation Start' 11/15/24) to waterproofing deps (e.g., 'Sheet waterproofing +48h post-stripping for cure, risk: Wet substrates void warranty').
Updates as Present Truth: Weekly new Gantt PDFs in 1F → re-map to baseline (fast-reasoning diffs changes, e.g., 'Delayed exterior skin impacts air barriers—trigger CO exhibit').

sections.name: Human Oversight Integration
details: Baked-in from Start: Mandatory 'Review & Approve' for outputs (e.g., editable tables for parsed essentials/risks/exhibits in PhaseLayout—e.g., tweak lead time from 4 to 6 weeks). Human-in-the-loop for high-risk (e.g., insurance).

sections.name: Skipped/Deferred Features
details: Anonymization: Skipped—low risk tolerance for small firm.
Interoperability: Skipped—low portal/BIM use; minimal exports (CSV/JSON) as stretch.
Togal.ai: Skipped—pure Grok AI; not better for contract/text focus.

sections.name: Standards Alignment
details: Minimal: Embed lightweight CSI/NRCA playbooks (JSON in phase-config.ts) for parsing/merging—proposal CSI priority + contract overlays + manual resolution. No deeper AIA unless value-add.

sections.name: Scalability Features
details: Two Dashboards: Enki Dashboard (home/landing—project hub with access to phases/features); Dev Dashboard (internal—token usage, chat summaries/todos).
Multi-Project: Centralized view/logging in Enki dash; shared mappings/playbooks across jobs.
Token/ROI Tracking: Log in dev_logs for dev dash.

sections.name: AI Optimizations
details: OCR Fallback: Tesseract for scanned Gantts/specs (integrate in ai-actions.ts if pdf-parse yields low text).
Contextual Search: Keyword/embedding search across sections (e.g., 'VOC risks' pulls from safety/insurance PDFs)—implement with Supabase or Grok fast-reasoning.

sections.name: Implementation Notes
details: Latency Trade: Accept in 1A for downstream speed (pdf-lib for splits).
Edge Cases: Visual Gantts need OCR; amendments via 'append' with audits.
UI/UX: 1A progress toasts; phase buttons for 'View PDF' or 'Parse Now'; editable tables for oversight/merges.
Pure Grok AI: Hybrid (Grok 4 breakdown, fast-reasoning refinements)—no third-party like Togal.
